SettingsDevicesAuthorizationDescription: Pairing grants the phone full mobile access: session summaries, full conversation text, tool details including diffs and terminal output, task logs, approvals, session controls, new-session creation, and approval or question responses. The desktop removes terminal control characters only; paths, command output, and possible secrets are not otherwise redacted. Pair only with a device you trust and control. Authorization is stored securely with the trusted device until you choose Forget.

SettingsExperimentalCodeModeDescription: Offers run_code, which lets the model write one program that chains tool calls instead of calling them one by one; permissions still apply to every call (plugins.code-mode). Needs a trusted Node runtime (rebon node install). /codemode on|off changes a single session.
SettingsExperimentalIntro: Features still being tried out. They can change or go away, and they are off unless you turn them on. A change reaches running sessions at once; what a session starts with applies to new sessions.
SettingsExperimentalModelRoutingDescript: A classifier picks the provider, model and reasoning effort from each new session's first prompt (plugins.model-routing). It needs a router backend: configure it with /settings in the CLI or the model-routing skill. Sessions already routed keep their model.
SettingsGeneralHostedCloseDescription: Each session runs in its own process and outlives the window, which is what lets a terminal pick the conversation up. This is how long it waits.
SettingsGeneralSessionDeleteDescription: By default Rebon only stops listing it: the files stay on disk, and claude, codex or rebon can still resume it from a terminal. “Delete files too” removes the transcript for good.

SettingsRuntimeClaudeCodexFallbackDescri: Also load user- and project-level skills and commands from .claude/.codex at startup. When off, only Rebon and plugin directories are loaded. Takes effect after restarting Rebon.
SettingsRuntimeCoordinatorWorktreeDescri: The /ceo coordinator gives each worker an isolated git worktree so parallel changes do not interfere (coordinator.useWorktree).
SettingsRuntimeFastModeDescription: Send service_tier: priority for supported model requests, trading higher cost for faster output (features.fastMode).
SettingsRuntimeSessionOptionsDescription: Except for Plan, permission modes are saved as the user default in settings.json and inherited by new sessions; Plan affects only the current session. Context pruning and auto-compact remain per-session runtime options; adjust them in a running session with /config or the corresponding command.
SettingsRuntimeShellToolDescription: Which shell the agent runs commands through. Bash and PowerShell are peer tools with their own syntax guidance, permission rules, and approval prompts; Auto resolves per platform (PowerShell alongside Bash on Windows, PowerShell alone when Git Bash is missing). A change takes effect on the next turn, with no restart.
SettingsRuntimeShellToolUnavailable: No PowerShell runtime was found on this machine, so choosing PowerShell keeps using Bash.
SettingsRuntimeSubAgentsDescription: Allow the main loop to delegate to Explore, Plan, and other sub-agents through the Agent tool. When off, the Agent tool and delegation guidance are hidden, and /ultrawork and /ceo cannot spawn workers.
SettingsShortcutsRecordHint: Shortcuts are read-only and show the current effective bindings.
SettingsSkillsEmptyDescription: Built-in skills load with the engine. Add your own with New skill, or put one at ~/.rebon/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
SettingsStatusLineAssistantHint: Runs once after each assistant reply lands.
SettingsStatusLineHeaderHint: Shown to the right of the session title, rerun on an interval.
SettingsStatusLineLatestOnlyHint: Use this for a command reporting conversation-wide state: otherwise it runs once per past message and prints the same line under each.
SettingsStatusLinePreviewEmpty: Press Run to try it once against the current conversation.
SettingsStatusLineUseDefaultHint: Writes the bundled script and fills in all three slots.
SettingsStatusLineUserHint: Runs once under each message you send.
SidebarArchiveBlockedAgentsTooltip: Stop its unfinished agents before archiving
SidebarArchiveBlockedRunningTooltip: Stop this chat before archiving it
SidebarArchiveConfirmDescription: The project is hidden from Projects & chats and its conversations are archived with it. You can recover it from sidecar metadata if needed.
SidebarDeleteConfirmDescription: This removes it from the app library. Running sessions must be stopped first.
SidebarDeleteSessionHideDescription: Rebon stops listing it. Its files stay on disk, and it can still be resumed from a terminal. To delete the files too, change this in Settings › General.
SidebarDeleteSessionFilesDescription: Its transcript files are removed from disk for good. This can't be undone. Running conversations must be stopped first.
SidebarRemoveProject: Remove project and hide its chats
SidebarTrustProjectDescription: Do you trust the contents of this directory? Working in an untrusted directory increases prompt-injection risk.
SidebarUnarchiveTooltip: Move this chat out of the archive
UpdateCloseCliBody: {count} Rebon CLI/TUI process(es) bundled with the app are still running. Close them and continue the update? (Only the app-bundled CLI is affected.)
WorkflowStudioDynamicPromptHint: Prompt is generated by the script at run time:
WorkflowStudioExpired: This review is no longer pending; edits cannot be submitted
WorkflowStudioFilePermHint: Read-only, or an isolated worktree sandbox
WorkflowStudioNodesSectionHint: Drop onto a phase to add
WorkflowStudioPaletteHint: Drag onto an agent on the canvas
WorkflowStudioPermApplyHint: Give write-heavy nodes their own worktree sandbox; keep the rest read-only.
WorkflowStudioSchemaApplyHint: Schema nodes validate their output; any agent failure stops the whole workflow immediately — completed results stay cached, so a corrected resume replays them.
WorkflowStudioSchemaSectionHint: Drop on an agent = structured validation
WorkflowStudioSelectHint: Click a node on the canvas to inspect and edit; all edits are bundled into one revision request.
WorkflowStudioSubmitFailed: Submit failed, your edits are kept: {error}
SettingsSkillsAppliesToNewSessions: Saved. New sessions pick this up; running ones keep their skills.
SettingsSkillsCreated: Created {path}. Edit it to write the skill's instructions.
SettingsSkillsDeleteConfirm: Click again to delete the folder
SettingsSkillsNameBadCharacter: Use lowercase letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter or digit.
SettingsSkillsNameTaken: A skill with that name already exists.
SettingsSkillsNewDescriptionPlaceholder: When should the agent use it? (optional)
SettingsSkillsPromptTruncated: Showing the first {lines} lines — open the file for the rest.
SettingsSkillsSaveFailed: Could not save the skill switches: {error}
SettingsMcpAdded: Added {name}. Test it, or start a new session to use it.
SettingsMcpAppliesToNewSessions: Saved. Sessions use the new settings from their next turn.
SettingsMcpImportHint: Paste the mcpServers JSON from a server's README, Claude Desktop or Cursor. Servers with the same name are replaced.
SettingsMcpNameTaken: There is already a server named {name}.
SettingsMcpProblemKey: Sessions refuse `{key}` — remove it, or every server in this file fails to load.
SettingsMcpProblemMissingCommand: No command — sessions will fail to load the servers in this file.
SettingsMcpProblemMissingUrl: No URL — sessions will fail to load the servers in this file.
SettingsMcpProblemNotObject: Not a server object — fix it in config.json.
SettingsMcpProblemTransport: Sessions do not support the `{transport}` transport; use stdio, http or sse, or turn it off.
SettingsMcpSubtitle: Tools from MCP servers for your sessions. Sessions share one process per stdio server. Same config as the CLI's /mcp.
SettingsMcpWebSocketUnsupported: WebSocket MCP servers are not supported; use an http or sse URL.
SettingsProviderDefaultsEmpty: Add a provider below, then pick the model new sessions use here.
SettingsProviderDefaultsNoModels: This provider lists no models yet — fetch them on its page.
SettingsProviderDefaultsEffortHint: For models that think; others ignore it
SettingsProviderDefaultsNote: You can still switch model and effort per chat from the composer.
SettingsProviderNameEmpty: The provider needs a name — nothing is saved until it has one.
SettingsProviderNameDuplicate: Another provider is already called {name} — rename one; nothing is saved until the names differ.
SettingsProviderTestNoUrl: Fill in the Base URL first.
SettingsProviderTestPlaceholders: Replace the placeholder parts of the Base URL (the ones in braces) first.
SettingsProviderTestUnsupported: This vendor has no model-list endpoint to test against — start a chat to check the key.
SettingsProviderKeyEnvMissing: The environment variable {name} is not set for Rebon — set it and restart, or paste the key.
SettingsMcpRunningIdle: Running · no session is using it; stops after a minute idle · PID {pid}
SettingsMcpRunningMany: {count} processes running (one per project) · used by {sessions} sessions
SettingsMcpRestart: Restart it for every session; each one reconnects on its next call
SettingsMcpRestarted: Restarted {name}. Sessions connect to the new process on their next call.
SettingsMcpNotRunning: {name} is not running, so there was nothing to restart.
SettingsMcpStoppedEverywhere: Turned off {name} and stopped it in every session.
SettingsMcpSharedHint: All sessions use one process. Turn this off for a server that keeps state per connection, such as one that drives a browser: each session then starts its own.
SettingsMcpHostFailed: Could not reach the MCP host: {error}
SettingsMcpNoProjects: No recent projects yet. Start a session in a project to manage its servers here.
SettingsMcpProjectSubtitle: Servers from this project's .mcp.json, and which global servers run in it. Approvals and per-project switches are saved in .rebon/settings.local.json and apply to this project only.
SettingsMcpProjectEmptyDescription: Add one below. It is written to .mcp.json in the project, which is usually shared with the repository.
SettingsMcpApproveAllHint: Servers added to .mcp.json later run without asking. The ones you rejected stay off.
SettingsMcpProjectGlobalGroup: Global servers in this project · {count} · {on} on here
SettingsMcpProjectGlobalEmpty: No global servers. Add them under Global; they are written to ~/.rebon/config.json.
SettingsMcpStoppedInProject: Turned off {name} in this project and stopped it for this project's sessions.
SettingsMcpRestartProject: Restart it for this project's sessions; each one reconnects on its next call
